registry.toolKbDesc: Collect and search long-form text: create/edit entries, tag them, full-text search, import txt / Markdown files, synced across devices

kb.emptyHint: Click “New entry” to write one, or use “Import file” to pull in an existing txt / Markdown file.
kb.tagsPh: Separate with commas or spaces, e.g. backend, auth
kb.contentPh: Plain text and Markdown are both fine. Content is synced to your other devices.
kb.deleteMsg: “{title}” will be deleted, and the deletion is synced to your other devices. This cannot be undone.
kb.loadFailed: Failed to load the knowledge base: {err}
kb.errNoTitle: Add a title, or write something in the content first.
kb.importPick: Pick a text file to import
kb.importSafety: Only plain-text files are supported ({exts}); PDF / Word need text extraction, which is not supported yet.
kb.importEmpty: The file is empty — nothing to import.
